checks: Exact named tests in native-commands.json; paired source syntax
cost: kids O(n), locals O(n+sum d_h log d_h), emit O(n) on valid acyclic local-order tree. projective O(n) on rooted valid trees. Dec adds lin/morph costs and string rendering; no learned-model inference cost or accuracy measured here.
description: of_words projects lemma/tag/head/rel. kids clamps out-of-range heads to0; projective computes contiguous subtree ranges. locals sorts head/child lists by supplied permutation; emit traverses them. Dec uses learned lin/morph, case/article/two-pass render and spacing; R2 overrides head orders or full order, spelling and output-position flips.
forward: of_words projects lemma/tag/head/rel. kids clamps out-of-range heads to0; projective computes contiguous subtree ranges. locals sorts head/child lists by supplied permutation; emit traverses them. Dec uses learned lin/morph, case/article/two-pass render and spacing; R2 overrides head orders or full order, spelling and output-position flips.
inverse: For projective valid tree and compatible permutation, emit(locals(t,o))=o; arbitrary crossing order can fail. R2 plus same decoder/hints reconstructs forms/spaces encoded with final spacing false. Normal forms discard original case, order and whitespace; ambiguous antecedents remain.

R2 space flips cannot make final token have trailing space because decode tests for next form. Raw spelling suppresses capitalization. kids clamping is not validation of cycles or uniqueness; malformed graphs have no totality guarantee.
limitations: No annotator/model loading, live corpus, full suite, teacher, GPU or persistent-learning evidence. No executable percentage surrogate: categorical codecs/effects need a useful metric before future caps 1/2/5/10%.
state: Layer representations, diagnostic residuals and fixed environment state; see scoped catalog.
